summary: Reproduced that LMCache and FlexKV derived external-store lengths larger than the caller-provided effective KV boundary, then capped both backend-specific committed-length calculations by kv_len_to_handle. Added CPU mock regressions for normal and speculative calculations plus the independent case where a larger caller bound must not extend the backend-derived length.

tests.what_was_measured: Both LMCache and FlexKV passed 9 normal-mode or 8 speculative-mode tokens/slots to their external stores when kv_len_to_handle was 4; four issue-specific subtests failed. Two then-incorrect independent-case expectations also failed and were corrected to preserve the existing speculative length of 8. Raw output: reports/j-22d2b5550954/raw/failing-before.txt

3 tests passed with 6 backend subtests: both stores honor a limit of 4 in normal and speculative modes, while a limit of 12 preserves the speculative backend-derived length of 8. Raw output: reports/j-22d2b5550954/raw/passing-after.txt
All configured formatting, lint, syntax, registry, and repository policy hooks passed for the changed source and regression test. Raw output: reports/j-22d2b5550954/raw/pre-commit.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned GPU was identified as AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950 (reports/j-22d2b5550954/raw/gpu-info.txt), but no GPU execution was used because the defect is deterministic CPU-side slicing of token IDs and slot-index metadata before either optional external connector is called.

remaining_limitations: LMCache and FlexKV are not installed in the prepared interpreter, so validation uses dependency stubs and exercises the actual cache_finished_req implementations with mocked connectors; no live external-cache service integration was run.
No model, semantic-accuracy, distributed, or multi-node claim is made; those paths are not required to establish this metadata-boundary defect.
An open upstream candidate, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34541, independently proposes the same two source caps; it was inspected but is not merged into the recorded base.
